name: MATSim
description: MATSim (Multi-Agent Transport Simulation) is an open-source, large-scale agent-based framework for modeling daily travel demand, traffic flows, and mobility choices. Millions of synthetic agents optimize activity schedules through co-evolutionary replanning in response to congestion and policy changes.
reputation: Standard open-source tool in transportation research and policy evaluation worldwide.
notes: Highly scalable for metropolitan areas; uses queue-based mobility simulation and iterative plan scoring.
